rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the olive fruit; say 橄欖樹 when you mean the tree.

example.english: The olive in this salad is too salty.
example.traditional: 呢碟沙律入面粒橄欖太鹹喇。
example.jyutping: ne1 dip6 saa1 leot6 jap6 min6 nap1 gaam3 laam2 taai3 haam4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to the olive tree rather than its fruit.

example.english: They planted several olive trees over there.
example.jyutping: go2 bin1 zung3 zo2 gei2 fo2 gaam3 laam2 syu6
